AGEN-PU-218 11/22
PREVENTING RUNOFF
WITH CYCLE AND SOAK IRRIGATION
Figure 1. Maximum runtime per cycle graph for clay soils
Figure 1. Maximum runtime per cycle graph for clay soils

Using the Maximum Irrigation Cycle Runtimes table,
the maximum runtime that should be applied to the
turfgrass is 5 minutes per cycle. This requires at least
6 cycles to be ran throughout the day to meet the
irrigation recommendation of 30 minutes.

► You want to program 45 minutes of irrigation into
three 15-minute cycles on your irrigation controller
for Zone 1.

(Example: 5:00 a.m. + 15-minute irrigation cycle
+ 1-hour soak time = 6:15 a.m.)

► Only assign additional zones that require three
cycles to Program A. These zones will water
automatically after each Zone 1 cycle during its
soak time. Subsequent start times may need to
be adjusted if the combined cycle runtime of the
additional zones is greater than the soak time.

* Assumes minimum 1 hour between irrigation
cycles on non-sloped landscapes.
1 As a water conservation practice, it is not
recommended to irrigate for more than 1
hour at a time.
